scope: Off-policy single-decision diagnostic. Archived policy determined states and remaining recorded placements. No counterfactual episodes, survival estimates, development screening or holdout played.

selection.fixed40: Same ten archived expanded top-out training games as prior audit. Shuffle unique index entries (Random(139425)); first ten distinct seeds. Floors at 10% and 50% of each game plus 512 and 32 placements before its recorded end. Every archived replay verified to its final board. No seed in either arm danger sources, development or holdout.
selection.supplemental: Same ten archived expanded training games. Capture state at distances 16, 4 and 1 before recorded top-out, plus the first two archived moves in the last 512 per game where actual legal CROSS count decreases to below 16. Membership uses the archived move and board geometry, never the tested logits or their flips. Selection tags may overlap. Groups indicate their number of distinct boards.

method: Native exact exhaustive preparation, one original CPU FP32 incumbent shortlist per state, sorted by original order on ties. Verify exact loaded checkpoint hash, teacher and identical tensor digest at every direct weight, full/fixed incumbent bitwise equality and replay of all 10 games to final-board hash. Weight logits agree bitwise with incumbent plus w*(f_after-f_before), f=log1p(min(N,16))/log(17). Overridden margin is ordinary incumbent logit of its greedy choice minus that of the weighted choice. CROSS counts are uncapped numbers of legal landings. Move arrays use [rotation,x,y,z,w].

only_mobility_improvable_board.caveat: Algebraic break-even on this archived board only. No unregistered weight was evaluated or proposed for survival.

full_action_audit.method: For all 23 all-zero shortlists and 37 with varying capped mobility, enumerate every canonical physical rotation and in-bounds lateral origin, bypassing target protection or teacher truncation. Independently compute protected set at the actually recovered target. Calculate native_scores without a target filter for every legal action, including all real layer clears; compute exact CROSS origins after each. Verify all recorded board hashes, all shortlist placements, raw ranges, and the incumbent move/z/after count, and independently materialize any better witness. Witnesses maximize capped mobility, then primary teacher utility, then secondary teacher score. Positions come from archived behavior; no continuations or fresh games were scored.
